content.short: XDEFI Wallet is a non-custodial wallet for storing, swapping and sending crypto and NFTs across 15 blockchains.
content.description: XDEFI Wallet is a non-custodial wallet that lets you securely store, swap, and send NFTs and crypto across 15 blockchains. More than 150,000 people trust XDEFI Wallet, and it holds a 5-star rating on the Chrome Web Store. Swap, bridge, send, and store more than 10,000 assets across Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum, THORChain, Avalanche, Polygon, Fantom, Bitcoin, Binance Chain, BNB Chain, Doge, Terra, Litecoin, and Bitcoin Cash. Assets span Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum, THORChain, Avalanche, Polygon, Fantom, Bitcoin, Binance Chain, BNB Chain, Doge, Terra, Litecoin, and Bitcoin Cash.
